Our practice

Thoughtful products and spaces begin with the people who use them. From material studies to technical coordination, the practice connects design intent with craft, performance, and the realities of making.

Spotlight on Public Space

A junction carries ten thousand people a day and gives almost none of them somewhere to stand. Working with paint, barricades and a weekend of labour, the intervention tests what a street can do before anything permanent is built — and measures whether it worked.

Expertise

Urban Systems

Tactical intervention, Mith Chowki. Crossing distances cut by a third; four refuge islands added; no kerb moved.
